reviewer_role: Separate protocol audit by the materials/evaluator implementation agent; unblinded, not an independent blind quality rating or human Gold.
scope: Read frozen plan, rubric, packet, references, 8 saved request bodies and result records. Write this new diagnostic only. No model calls, score changes, or input edits.

original_preregistered_result.only_automated_gate_failure: cashflow-change-d-r2: reported percentage misses hidden 0.02-percentage-point tolerance
original_preregistered_result.fact_count_interpretation: 24 records across four six-fact outputs plus 8 across four two-fact outputs. These are 32 repeated extraction instances, not 32 independent facts or tasks.

precision_diagnostic.interpretation: 保留预声明7/8 gate。-53.2%是正确的一位小数四舍五入，不应称为计算错误。隐藏容差更严格，而任务未告知展示精度，这是基准设计缺陷。该诊断不能将原gate改为8/8，也不代表分析质量全部通过。
precision_diagnostic.future_version_action: 在新版本任务中明确至少两位小数及四舍五入规则，或预先声明与报告小数位匹配的舍入区间；不可在看见结果后静默改本轮评分。

input_equivalence.wrappers: Claude: system top-level + user messages, native thinking/output_config. DeepSeek: system/user chat messages, thinking/reasoning_effort and top_p=0.95. Same task text does not mean byte-identical entire HTTP requests or identical tokenization.
input_equivalence.evidence_boundary: Application-saved request bodies and pinned sender code verified. No independent wire capture or provider-side proof of effective settings or model weights.

repeat_findings.interpretation: Both repeats agree on the scoped fact records. The complete answers still differ beyond ordering; this does not establish deterministic generation or identical semantic quality.

cost_and_latency.interpretation: Costs are uncached public-price estimates. DeepSeek second repeats report 3584 cached input tokens each; no cache discount was applied to these estimates. Elapsed times include channel/service effects and two observations per task/profile; do not infer architecture speed or reliable population latency.

other_scientific_limits.finding: Two task variants reuse one AMD excerpt and six unique source facts. The second task does not independently test new factual coverage.
other_scientific_limits.required_interpretation: A small fixed-material pilot, not general extraction/report-writing accuracy.

other_scientific_limits.finding: Sonnet adaptive/high 8k and DeepSeek enabled/low 16k differ in protocol, supported sampling, output caps, reasoning policy and provider channel. Reported aliases are not pinned model-weight identities.
other_scientific_limits.required_interpretation: Compare these actual service configurations; no causal claim about model family alone or equal compute.

other_scientific_limits.finding: S,D,D,S then D,S,S,D counterbalances model position within tasks, but tasks are blocked and only two repeats are observed. Caching, time and service effects remain.
other_scientific_limits.required_interpretation: No significance test, reliability rate, or universal winner from this design.

other_scientific_limits.finding: Plan, task packets, hidden rubrics and references were pinned before calls. evaluate.py is not among execution-pin.json files and was completed during execution.
other_scientific_limits.required_interpretation: Describe rules as preregistered, not all grading implementation as immutable before execution. Preserve evaluator hash and this diagnostic; freeze evaluator/test version in the next pilot.

other_scientific_limits.finding: Program checks verify record fields, exact row quotes, calculation-result numbers, length and gap count. They do not prove free-text formula semantics, all analysis claims, complete causal attribution, or gap truthfulness.
other_scientific_limits.required_interpretation: Keep blind qualitative review separate. Program 7/8 is not report-quality accuracy.

other_scientific_limits.finding: The selected table includes a 2021 column although target facts cover 2023/2022. Claims that no 2021 data exists in the excerpt would be inaccurate; lack of full earlier trends is a different limitation.
other_scientific_limits.required_interpretation: Qualitative reviewers must use the actual packet, not only the target-year list.

other_scientific_limits.finding: Expected records were checked against frozen source cells and raw inline facts by agents; this is not independently approved human Gold. Blind packets remove explicit model/cost labels, but outputs can retain stylistic cues.
other_scientific_limits.required_interpretation: State reviewer type and preserve blind mapping separately; do not claim double-blind or inter-rater reliability.

recommended_reporting_zh: 8次均完整返回；32条重复提取记录与来源一致，覆盖6个独立源事实。按预登记程序规则7/8通过，唯一失败是正确的一位百分比舍入未满足未告知模型的隐藏精度要求。保留原分数，并将它作为基准设计问题单独说明。分析质量以单独盲审为准，不据此给模型排总榜。
